note: One run per doctrine scenario, same cohort/ tree, shipped defaults. v1.23 (2026-08-26): retrained onto the post-acoustics tree because every v1.22 member was OBS_DIM 220 against a tree at 351 and could not be loaded — the fleet was unreproducible. Members for patrol_brique, platoon and platoon_hard come from DECLARED seed searches, never laundered: their reporting channel is bimodal and the search is recorded in seed_search with every seed tried. closed_on_root_report_rate and stacked_rate are BEHAVIOUR MARKERS as of 2026-08-26 (owner-decided), not gates: they are measured and printed on every surface and no longer block a seal. seed_search declares the seeds a member was CHOSEN from; seed_spread declares every other same-config draw the record holds.

referenced_history.squad_abl_full_s3: B3 2026-08-06, Box(137): the three-seed original. Kept because one seed per arm is what its v1.19 replication has, and the older result is the stronger evidence on the axes it measured.

referenced_history.squad_v10b: Confirmation seed (13) for the flagship squad scenario. squad_v10 published at 0.92 ± 0.05 against squad_v8's 0.98 ± 0.03 and squad_v9's 0.97 ± 0.03 — overlapping intervals, Fisher p = 0.10 and 0.21, so not a difference by this repo's own rule, but at the low end of the band with root death 0.30 vs 0.23/0.18 (p = 0.34 / 0.068). One seed cannot say whether that is the scenario or the draw; two can bound it. The manifest member stays seed 12 either way, because it is also the ablation's control arm and the three arms must share a seed.
referenced_history.squad_v11: Price arm, done_false=-2.0, single-variable against squad_v10 (same tree, seed, steps). CONFIRMED the mechanism: root claims 178 -> 0, give-back -7pt -> +2pt, messages/ep 101 -> 78, distance from objective under threat 11.21 -> 9.53. REJECTED as a fix: root-closed 84% -> 0%, so the price does not repair the DONE channel, it closes it — the exact failure rewards.py warns about. Final success 0.92 -> 0.96 is NOT significant (Fisher p = 0.37; pooled p = 0.076).
referenced_history.squad_v12: Price arm, root_done_bonus_first_claim_only=true at the shipped done_false=-0.5. The lever squad_v11 argues for: at squad_v10's own claim precision of 0.433 it leaves the FIRST truthful claim at EV +1.014 and drops the second and later to -0.284, so spam stops paying without the honest report going -EV. Single-variable against squad_v10.
referenced_history.platoon_hard_v5_seed12: The v1.22 platoon_hard member, and NOT a same-config draw of the v1.23 one: it was trained with the D4 rescue ARMED (rescue_max=3, rescue_patience=700, rescue_kl_scale=0.5) while every v1.23 job ran with the rescue off. That difference was NOT intended — scripts/campaigns/v1_23_fleet.jobs simply carried no rescue flags, so the campaign silently dropped a setting the shipped member had. Disclosed rather than reconciled, because the outcome argues for the new configuration: platoon_hard_v7_seed13 converges to PUBLISHABLE (gap 7) with no salvage at all, and 'the rescue is a converter, not a cure' is this project's own finding (ROADMAP 2026-08-21). It also plausibly explains why v6_seed12 missed the bar at gap 13 — no rescue to catch its mid-run dip. Any comparison between v5 and a v1.23 platoon_hard run is therefore NOT single-variable.

waives.provenance:cohort_tree: squad_ctrl_v2_seed12 trained at commit 7247122 (tree 81a9cec6); the other eight members trained during the v1.23 campaign at tree ee378f01. The delta is commits 297cf35 and de1f53d — the comm-model marker waiver and the checkpoint-selection change that reads it. BOTH ARE INERT FOR THIS MEMBER: COMM_MODEL_MARKER_WAIVERS has a single entry, keyed 'jammed', and `squad` is comm_model='global', so `report_gate_waived` resolves False and best_save_gate takes exactly the pre-change branch. The training path is therefore identical, and only the recorded tree differs. ROOT CAUSE, recorded because it was a planning error and not bad luck: scripts/campaigns/v1_23_fleet.jobs deliberately carried NO squad job, on the reasoning that squad_ctrl_v2_seed12 was bit-identical in CONFIG to one. That was true and beside the point — it was trained before the campaign froze the tree, so it is not on the frozen tree. A squad job in the campaign would have cost 45 minutes and avoided this. The clean fix is a squad retrain on the fleet tree; it is NOT taken now because the price-dispersion cycle retrains every member imminently, which resolves it at no extra cost.
